statement: Community SPI map assigns factory IMU calibration 0x6020..0x6037, factory stick calibration 0x603D..0x604E (left/right 9 bytes), body RGB 0x6050..0x6052, button RGB 0x6053..0x6055, left grip RGB 0x6056..0x6058 and right grip RGB 0x6059..0x605B. Subcommand 0x10 performs little-endian SPI reads with a bounded 0x1D-byte length.
